title: Resources / Brand tools and repositories

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content-area capture; visible default tab states

slide_intent: Make authoritative tools easy to locate so designers can start from the intended assets and identify access requirements.
strategic_value: A categorized resource directory can reduce inconsistent recreation of IBM elements and clarify where restricted assets require permission.
demonstration: The webpage arranges resource cards under design tools, typography, color, grid, logos, iconography, illustration, photography, data visualization, animation and other resources.
practical_value: Identify the appropriate source library or starter kit and distinguish public references from resources marked as requiring IBM ID.

content_islands.name: Design tools, type and color
content_islands.spec: Begin with library cards, Plex repositories and palette/accessibility resources in small card grids.

content_islands.name: Grid and logos
content_islands.spec: Follow grid references with logo-request and co-branding cards, retaining IBM-ID qualifiers.

content_islands.name: Iconography
content_islands.spec: Group UI icons, app icons and pictograms into separate card families for libraries, starters and requests.

content_islands.name: Imagery and data
content_islands.spec: Continue with illustration kits, photography assets and data-visualization resources.

content_islands.name: Animation and other resources
content_islands.spec: Close with motion links and Carbon/Brand Center references, preserving access labels and ancillary footer.

reference_purposes.Application: The directory maps design tasks to named starter files, libraries, repositories and guidance.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Logo requests, co-branding, photography assets, video guidance and Brand Center resources carry IBM-ID access labels.
